name: Tonkatsu ENbiton - Changi City Point
description: Tonkatsu ENbiton, a destination for authentic tonkatsu experiences. We pride ourselves on sourcing the finest pork from renowned farms in Japan and around the world, ensuring the highest standards of quality and flavour in every dish. Our commitment to excellence ensures that every cut of pork we serve maintains the highest standards of quality and flavour.
